note: Family-owned, 80 acres with nature trails, a 5-acre spring-fed lake with a beach and boat rentals, and planned activities. The sites on the water are the Lakeside row along the lake's north shore; the rest are wooded and open sites up the hill. --Claude
summary: Confirmed fees $40-48 (operator's price page), 50A/water/sewer, pull-throughs, showers, dump, store. Season from a bare year_round:false to Apr 15 - Nov 15 (the note's 'May-Oct' was wrong). Added phone booking and the 3-night holiday minimum. Lakefront plotted: earned only for about 9 Lakeside sites. Rig length and site count not stated.
flags: GATE FACTS: posted W/E $40, FHU to $48 (operator, no year on page; footer 2026), under $50. Good Sam: not found in the cached directory. No gateway within 40 km (Cuyahoga Valley NP 69 km). RV Life 4*/$$. GOOGLE MAPS: 4.0 from 145 reviews; phone 330-337-9381 matches. Not a family stay.

WATERFRONT PLOT (stored lakefront, earned narrowly): the operator's map shows one row on the lake, 'Lakeside' sites 2-18 evens (about 9 sites) along the north shore. Imagery (leaf-off) shows RVs on that row within about 5-15 m of the water over open bank, no berm. All other sites (Chaparral, Hickory, Birch Trail, Woodside, Dogwood, Whippoorwill, Sunrise etc., roughly 200+ on the map) are in woods 60-400 m away with no water. The boat beach is across the south side. Whether those lakeside sites are sold nightly or held by seasonals isn't stated; they look settled on imagery (decks, sheds). If they are seasonal the claim isn't usable by a nightly visitor; a re-audit might go to 'lakeview' or 'not waterfront'. Not changed.

LONG-STAY TEST 4 unknown: 'Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Seasonal Sites', and a daily rate is posted, so test 2 passes. Share isn't stated. The map shows 200+ numbered sites and imagery shows most occupied in winter/leaf-off with sheds or decks; a Google review: 'Weekend here in the past and have now became seasonal campers' (5 years ago), a reviewer 3 months ago calls it 'a nice neighborhood'. Also: 'Electric needs updated' (a year ago).
Rules line from map: 'NO ONE under 18 years old allowed to stay in the campground without adult supervision' and alcohol only at your site or the pavilion during dances. Not a criteria problem.
Pin at the entrance/parking area, about 130 m from the sites' centre; left.
